lcc_original: 空中的飛鳥也要七隻七隻地帶；公的和母的，使種存活於全地上；
notes: LCC restructures UNV 七公七母 (seven male / seven female) into 七隻七隻地帶…公的和母的: both H7651 tags land on the two 七隻, while H2145 (male) and H5347 (female) move to the later 公的/母的 clause.
UNV 可以留種(H2233)…活(H2421+T8763) is collapsed by LCC into 使種存活: 種 carries H2233 and 存活 carries the verbal complex WAH09001+WH02421+WTH8763.
LCC 於 replaces UNV 在 as the equivalent of H5921 (עַל); tagged accordingly.
The adverbial 地 in 七隻七隻地帶 is a Chinese grammatical particle (地₂), distinct from 地(H776) in 全地上, and is left unannotated.
H3605 (כָּל) attaches to 全 as WAH03605 following the UNV annotation pattern.
